VOCAB.en_def: animal skin that is treated and used to make bags, shoes, and clothes

VOCAB.collocation: genuine leather 真皮

VOCAB.en_def: a strong, heavy cloth used for bags, shoes, and tents
VOCAB.sentence: A: The bookstore wants to sell its own shopping bags, but the manager does not want plastic because many customers care about the environment, so which material should we use? VOCAB.collocation: a canvas bag 帆布袋

VOCAB.en_def: not letting water go through
VOCAB.sentence: A: I will be visiting construction sites in Keelung all next week, and the weather report says it will rain almost every day, so how can I keep my documents dry? B: Use a {{BLANK}} bag with a roll-top opening, because even heavy rain cannot get inside, and your plans and contracts will stay completely dry.
VOCAB.cn: A：下週我整週都要去基隆的工地，氣象報告說幾乎每天都會下雨，我要怎麼讓文件保持乾燥？ B：用一個捲口式開口的【防水】包，因為就算大雨也進不去，你的設計圖和合約都能保持完全乾燥。
VOCAB.collocation: a waterproof jacket 防水外套

VOCAB.en_def: able to last a long time without breaking
VOCAB.sentence: A: Our delivery workers carry heavy packages in their bags all day, and the cheap bags we bought last year all fell apart within a few months, so what should we buy now? B: We need more {{BLANK}} bags made of thick nylon with strong stitching, even if they cost more, because they will last for several years and save money.
VOCAB.cn: A：我們的送貨員整天用包包背重物，去年買的便宜包包幾個月內就都壞了，我們現在該買什麼？ B：我們需要更【耐用】的包包，用厚尼龍和堅固的縫線製成，即使比較貴，因為它們能用好幾年，反而省錢。
VOCAB.collocation: durable materials 耐用的材料

VOCAB.en_def: not heavy
VOCAB.sentence: A: The flight attendants at our airline walk through long airports every day with their bags, and many of them have complained about sore backs, so what can we do? B: We can give them new {{BLANK}} bags that weigh less than one kilogram when empty, so they will carry much less weight during long workdays.
VOCAB.cn: A：我們航空公司的空服員每天都要提著包包走過很長的機場，很多人抱怨背痛，我們能怎麼做？ B：我們可以發給他們空包重量不到一公斤的新款【輕量】包包，這樣他們在漫長的工作日中就能少背很多重量。
VOCAB.collocation: a lightweight suitcase 輕量行李箱

VOCAB.en_def: having a lot of room inside
VOCAB.sentence: A: I am going to Singapore for a week-long sales conference, and I need to bring business suits, product samples, and a laptop, so will my small bag be enough? B: No, you will need a more {{BLANK}} suitcase, because the samples take up a lot of room, and you may also bring back gifts from the clients.
VOCAB.cn: A：我要去新加坡參加為期一週的業務會議，需要帶西裝、產品樣品和筆電，我的小包包夠用嗎？ B：不夠，你需要一個更【寬敞】的行李箱，因為樣品很佔空間，而且你可能還會帶客戶送的禮物回來。
VOCAB.collocation: a spacious main compartment 寬敞的主隔層

VOCAB.en_def: small and using little space
VOCAB.sentence: A: Many young office workers in Taipei ride scooters to work, and they say large bags are hard to store under the seat, so what product should we design for them? B: We should design a {{BLANK}} bag that fits easily under a scooter seat but still holds a tablet, a wallet, and a raincoat.
VOCAB.cn: A：台北很多年輕上班族騎機車通勤，他們說大包包很難放進座墊下，我們該為他們設計什麼產品？ B：我們應該設計一款【小巧】的包包，能輕鬆放進機車座墊下，但還是能裝平板、皮夾和雨衣。
VOCAB.collocation: a compact design 小巧的設計

VOCAB.en_def: popular and in a style that many people like now
VOCAB.sentence: A: Our bags are well made and practical, but sales to young customers have been falling this year, so what do you think is the main problem? B: Young people want bags that look {{BLANK}}, so we should work with a popular designer and add brighter colors and modern shapes to our collection.
VOCAB.cn: A：我們的包包做工好又實用，但今年賣給年輕顧客的銷量一直下滑，你覺得主要問題是什麼？ B：年輕人想要看起來【時髦】的包包，所以我們應該和受歡迎的設計師合作，在產品系列中加入更亮的顏色和現代的造型。
VOCAB.collocation: fashionable accessories 時髦的配件

VOCAB.en_def: practical and useful, made to do a job well
VOCAB.sentence: A: The customer survey shows that business travelers do not care much about the color of a bag, so what do they want most when they choose one? B: They want a {{BLANK}} bag with many pockets, a laptop section, and a charging port, because they need to work in airports and hotels.
VOCAB.cn: A：顧客調查顯示商務旅客不太在意包包的顏色，那他們挑選時最想要的是什麼？ B：他們想要一個【實用】的包包，有很多口袋、筆電夾層和充電孔，因為他們需要在機場和飯店工作。
VOCAB.collocation: a simple, functional design 簡單實用的設計

VOCAB.en_def: the amount that something can hold
VOCAB.sentence: A: The hiking company wants to know which backpack it should rent to customers for the two-day mountain tour, because some customers carry a lot of clothes. B: Choose the one with a forty-liter {{BLANK}}, because it holds clothes, food, and water for two days, but it is still light enough for most people.
VOCAB.cn: A：登山公司想知道兩天山區行程該出租哪一款背包給客人，因為有些客人會帶很多衣服。 B：選四十公升【容量】的那一款，因為它能裝兩天份的衣服、食物和水，而且對大多數人來說還是夠輕。
VOCAB.collocation: a large storage capacity 大的收納容量

VOCAB.en_def: to arrange things in a neat and useful way
VOCAB.sentence: A: My bag is always so messy that I cannot find my pens, business cards, or keys when a client is waiting, and it makes me look unprofessional. B: You should {{BLANK}} your things with small pouches, putting each type of item in its own place, so you can find anything in a few seconds.
VOCAB.cn: A：我的包包總是很亂，客戶在等的時候我都找不到筆、名片或鑰匙，讓我看起來很不專業。 B：你應該用小收納袋來【整理】你的東西，把每一類物品放在固定的位置，這樣幾秒鐘就能找到任何東西。
VOCAB.collocation: organize your desk 整理你的桌面

VOCAB.en_def: to hold something and take it with you
VOCAB.sentence: A: The new rules at the factory say that workers cannot bring large bags onto the production floor, so where should they keep their personal things? B: They can only {{BLANK}} a small clear bag with their phone and water bottle, and everything else must stay in the lockers near the main entrance.
VOCAB.cn: A：工廠的新規定說工人不能帶大包包進入生產區，那他們的私人物品要放哪裡？ B：他們只能【攜帶】一個裝手機和水壺的小透明袋，其他東西都必須放在大門附近的置物櫃裡。
VOCAB.collocation: carry a heavy bag 提重包包

VOCAB.en_def: to put things into a bag or suitcase for a trip

VOCAB.cn: A：我飛東京的班機明天早上七點起飛，今晚在辦公室還有很多工作要做，我什麼時候才有時間準備？ B：你一到家就應該先【打包】行李，再做其他事，這樣你才能早點睡，也不會忘記任何重要的東西。
VOCAB.collocation: pack a suitcase 打包行李箱

VOCAB.en_def: to go from one place to another, especially far away

VOCAB.cn: A：我們業務經理兩週後要去日本、韓國和泰國，她只會帶一個包包，她該帶哪一種？ B：她會帶一個登機箱輕裝【出差】，因為可以帶上飛機，在每個機場都不必等行李。
VOCAB.collocation: travel light 輕裝旅行

VOCAB.en_def: able to be used again and again

VOCAB.cn: A：超市明年想停止提供塑膠袋，但有些購物者可能會不高興，我們要怎麼幫助他們改變習慣？ B：我們可以在結帳處附近販售便宜的【可重複使用】購物袋，並給自己從家裡帶袋子的顧客小折扣。
VOCAB.collocation: reusable shopping bags 可重複使用的購物袋

VOCAB.en_def: the part of a bag that you hold in your hand

VOCAB.collocation: a leather handle 皮革提把

VOCAB.en_def: safe and protected from being opened or stolen
VOCAB.sentence: A: Many tourists in our city have complained about pickpockets in crowded night markets, so what kind of bag should our travel shop recommend to them? B: We should recommend a {{BLANK}} bag with hidden zippers and a lock, so thieves cannot open it easily while people are walking through crowds.
VOCAB.cn: A：我們城市很多觀光客抱怨在擁擠的夜市遇到扒手，我們旅行用品店應該推薦他們什麼樣的包包？ B：我們應該推薦有隱藏式拉鍊和鎖的【安全】包包，這樣人們走在人群中時，小偷就不容易打開。
VOCAB.collocation: keep your valuables secure 保管好你的貴重物品

VOCAB.sentence: A: The new pizza restaurant near our office is always full at lunchtime, and people say the pizza base is soft but crispy, so what is their secret? VOCAB.en_def: a liquid mix of flour, eggs, and milk used for cakes or pancakes
VOCAB.sentence: A: The breakfast shop is going to start selling pancakes next month, but the cooks are worried that they will be too slow during the morning rush, so what can they do? VOCAB.en_def: a powder made from wheat, used to make bread and cakes
VOCAB.sentence: A: The price of our bread has gone up twice this year, and some customers have started to complain, so why are our costs rising so fast? VOCAB.en_def: a substance used to make bread rise and become soft
VOCAB.sentence: A: The new baker's bread came out flat and hard this morning, and we had to throw away three trays of rolls, so what went wrong in the kitchen? VOCAB.en_def: a sweet substance used in food and drinks
VOCAB.sentence: A: Many of our customers have asked for healthier cakes because they are trying to eat better, but they still want them to taste good, so what should we change? VOCAB.en_def: a soft yellow food made from cream
VOCAB.sentence: A: Our croissants are much more expensive than the ones at the supermarket, and some customers ask why they should pay more, so what should we tell them? VOCAB.cn: A：我們的可頌比超市的貴很多，有些顧客問為什麼要多付錢，我們該怎麼告訴他們？ B：告訴他們我們用的是真正的法國【奶油】，讓我們的可頌有濃郁的風味和許多輕盈酥脆的層次，這是便宜可頌沒有的。

VOCAB.sentence: A: The new kitchen helper is making cookies for the first time, and she is not sure what to do after measuring all the ingredients, so can you help her? B: Tell her to {{BLANK}} the butter and sugar first until they are soft and smooth, and then slowly add the eggs and the flour.
VOCAB.cn: A：新來的廚房助手第一次做餅乾，她量好所有材料後不確定接下來要做什麼，你能幫她嗎？ B：告訴她先把奶油和糖【攪拌】到柔軟滑順，然後再慢慢加入蛋和麵粉。

VOCAB.sentence: A: The bakery is thinking about buying a large machine for making bread dough, but it costs a lot of money, so is it really worth it? VOCAB.cn: A：麵包店考慮買一台製作麵團的大型機器，但要花很多錢，真的值得嗎？ B：值得，因為我們的烘焙師每天早上要花將近兩小時用手【揉】麵團，而機器只要十五分鐘就能做好同樣的工作。

VOCAB.sentence: A: Why do the bakers come to work at four o'clock in the morning, when the shop does not open until seven thirty? B: The bread dough needs about two hours to {{BLANK}} before it goes into the oven, so they must start very early to have fresh bread ready when customers arrive.
